intent_snapshot.goal: Introduce the Interaction protocol (InteractionRequest, InteractionChannel post/poll/withdraw) and move clarify questions, /approve plan approval, Lane decisions and escalations onto its github channel, which applies only the literal-user answers ADR 0039 Decisions 9 and 12 grant and posts every other literal-user operation as notice only, per D3 of docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-6; meet D3 in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-interaction-github.test.ts and tests/loop-daemon-decisions.test.ts with a fake GitHub port. Done looks like: each interaction_id produces exactly one marker comment and a repost returns already_posted; a request whose binding (plan_digest, record_revision or issue_revision) changed is reported stale and its comment edited to a withdrawn notice. Bound: a Lane decision or /approve marker posted in the pre-protocol format is still parsed.

Source BR-DEC-8, BR-DEC-10, BR-SCN-3; meet D3 github.accepts in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-interaction-github.test.ts. Done looks like: /approve <digest> and a Lane decision reply are applied with today's checks; a breaking Intent revision, stop and authorization request is posted as notice_only naming the local action, and a GitHub reply to it is not applied. Negative: replies from a non-allowlisted author, from the daemon identity, edited after creation, or carrying a different digest or record_revision are ignored.

attestations.summary: S3-AC1/AC2 met: one marker comment per interaction_id with already_posted on repost, moved plan_digest/record_revision/issue_revision reported stale and edited to a withdrawn notice, /approve and Lane replies applied only through verifyTrackerApproval/verifyLaneDecisionReply, local-only operations and escalations posted notice_only and never answered, pre-protocol markers still parsed; the antigravity mirrors have the same blob OIDs as the reviewed plugin files; blast radius medium (new interaction/ module plus additive escalation.ts/events.ts exports, no caller wired yet, no persisted shape).

advisory_findings.summary: changedBindingFields treats a field the request was never posted with as moved, but the test titled 'treats an absent binding field as unchanged' only compares a present field with itself, so the absent-field case is untested.

evidence.trigger: An escalation or clarify request is posted with binding {} or {issue_revision}, and the channel's binding() returns a subject-wide {plan_digest, issue_revision} → poll reports stale and edits the comment to a withdrawn notice even though no field of that request's own binding moved

advisory_findings.summary: find() accepts an interaction marker from a comment by any author, so a non-allowlisted commenter can pre-empt or pre-withdraw a request with a predictable id; this follows the pre-existing marker-from-any-author pattern in decision_relay.ts and planEscalation, and owner replies are still verified.

evidence.trigger: A non-allowlisted user posts '<!-- immune-brain:interaction=escalation:<key>|kind=escalation -->' (optionally with the withdrawn marker) before the daemon posts → post returns already_posted and the daemon never posts, or poll returns withdrawn
